dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Marco was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. During his time at the care center, Marco has shown fearful and defensive behavior, particularly around his kennel, where he will hard bark and lunge as handlers approach, and kennel fights on the way past other dogs. Once outside of the kennel, he has been tense and fixated on other dogs and has continued to show fearful behavior, seeking exit in unfamiliar situations; however, in calm environments with known handlers, he has shown social behavior. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with an experienced New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Marco
